text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—Curren Bouquetd'or is kind. Come to think 
of it, wherever she went, she was always 
empathizing with others.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"That's precisely why I want today to just 
be a day 'for her.' To make that happen, I 
put together a plan—"

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
—A flower exhibition... It sounds lovely. 
Flowers of all kinds from all over the 
world, gathered in one place—
choice_data_list: Glad you're looking forward to it!

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
Yes... Of course, that is part of it, but— 
............
choice_data_list: 楽しみなようでよかった！

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
...Your kindness... makes me so happy, 
Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: Well then, shall we get going— ...Oh?

text_block_list.name: Lost Girl
text_block_list.text: M-Mom...! W-Where are you...!?

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: —Looks like she's lost.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
It's okay... You'll see your mother soon. 
Let's go to the police box... together, 
all right?
choice_data_list:
Is there a police box around here...? Let 
me look it up.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, she was safely reunited with her 
mother, resolving the issue— but even 
after that...
choice_data_list: この辺に交番は……ちょっと調べてみるね

text_block_list.name: Fallen Man
text_block_list.text: O-Ow, ow, ow, ow, ow...!!

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
! It looks like that person fell down the 
stairs— Oh no, we have to go help them 
right away...!
choice_data_list: I'll go call an ambulance!
I'll call an ambulance just in case!

text_block_list.name: Troubled Old Woman
text_block_list.text:
Oh dear me... My grandchild's apartment 
should be right around here, though...
choice_data_list: 俺は救急車を呼んでおくよ！
私は救急車を呼んでおくよ！

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
Oh dear... The roads around here are quite 
intricate. If you'd like—shall I help you 
look for them?
choice_data_list: Do you know your grandchild's address?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
On the way, we ran into some people in 
deep trouble—
choice_data_list: お孫さんの住所はわかりますか？

text_block_list.name: Pale-Faced Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
...Ack, my battery died!? Oh no, I don't 
know this area at all...! Which way's the 
station...?!

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: Oh dear, how awful...! Let me guide—

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
choice_data_list: What's wrong?
What's wrong?

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
...The exhibition hours— I believe it's 
almost closing time...
choice_data_list: どうした？
どうしたの？

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
Even though you went out of your way to 
invite me... ...at this rate...―
choice_data_list:
More importantly, it's about what you want 
to do!

More importantly, it's about what you want 
to do!

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
choice_data_list: それより、君がどうしたいか、だよ！
それより、貴方がどうしたいか、だよ！

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: I want to help... them. That person.
choice_data_list: Then I want to do the same!
Then, I want to do that too!

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: ...! Thank you very much...!
choice_data_list: なら、俺もそうしたい！
なら、私もそうしたい！

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
"...I'm sorry. In the end—we didn't make 
it in time for the exhibition, did we?"
choice_data_list:
Still, we managed to save them properly, 
didn't we?

Still, we managed to save them properly, 
didn't we?

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
But... after all the trouble you went 
through to plan it, I ended up ruining 
everything...
choice_data_list: でも、ちゃんと助けられたじゃないか
でも、ちゃんと助けられたじゃない

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: T-Trainer-san...! This is—
choice_data_list: ……いや。実はもうひとつ、用意がある

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I made it by copying her mother, who said 
she used to make flower crowns for her. 
...Regardless of how well it turned out.
choice_data_list: フラワーアレンジメント。一応……手作りの

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: Why... do you do so much for me...?
choice_data_list: ...Why, you ask? ...Well—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"...She's kind. Infinitely so, as if her 
kindness has no bottom."
choice_data_list: ……どうしてって……それは――

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
However, I know now that this kindness was 
shaped and supported by the kindness of 
those around me. That is why—
choice_data_list:
I want to be one of those 'kind people' 
too.

I want to be one of those "kind people" 
too.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Kindness should be met with kindness. If I 
could play even the smallest part in 
bringing harmony to her heart—
choice_data_list: 俺も、“優しい人”のひとりでありたいんだ
私も、“優しい人”のひとりでありたいの

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
choice_data_list:
As a token of my feelings... this might be 
a bit clumsy, though...

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: That's—not true at all.
choice_data_list: その気持ちの証――にしては、拙いかも……

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
"Right now... I feel so warm inside. It 
feels as though the kindness you gave me 
is filling up my entire body—"

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
"It feels as though a landscape of harmony 
is spreading endlessly across my soul..."
choice_data_list:
Someday I want to give you an even greater 
gift, but...

I'm glad your feelings got through to 
them!

Thanks to you, maybe I can learn to be 
kinder too.

Thanks to you, maybe I can learn to be 
kinder too.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
"It feels as though a landscape of harmony 
is spreading endlessly across my soul..."
choice_data_list: いつか、もっと立派な贈り物をしたいけど
気持ちが伝わったならよかった！
君のおかげで俺も優しくなれていけるかも
貴方のおかげで私も優しくなれていけるかも

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
...I appreciate the thought. But— it 
doesn't matter whether it's admirable or 
not.
choice_data_list: いつか、もっと立派な贈り物をしたいけど
気持ちが伝わったならよかった！
君のおかげで俺も優しくなれていけるかも
貴方のおかげで私も優しくなれていけるかも

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
The feelings poured into it... will never 
fade away, after all.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
............ I have always――received far 
more than I deserve from you.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
Yes—you are the one who brings harmony to 
my heart.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: ...Fufufu. What strange things you say.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
From the very beginning... you always 
have. Trainer, you have always been such a 
kind person.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
In the past, and from now on as well... 
I've always noticed, you know.
